title: 酒店入住
goal: 在前台办理入住：报预订名、交押金、问早餐时间和无线网密码；房间没准备好时会寄存行李。
tips: 开口就说 I have a reservation under the name ...（我用……的名字预订了）。
很多酒店入住时会在信用卡上冻结一笔押金（deposit），退房后解冻，不是扣款。
欧洲很多城市要交城市税（city tax / tourist tax），通常入住时在前台现付。

exchanges.hearZh: 欢迎。您是要办理入住吗？
exchanges.reply: Yes. I have a reservation under the name Wang.
exchanges.replyZh: 是的。我用“王”这个名字预订了。

exchanges.hear: Can I see your passport and a credit card, please?
exchanges.hearZh: 请出示您的护照和一张信用卡。

exchanges.hear: We need a deposit of one hundred dollars. It'll be refunded when you check out.
exchanges.hearZh: 需要100美元押金，退房时退还。
exchanges.reply: OK. Can I pay the deposit by card?

exchanges.hear: I'm sorry, your room isn't ready yet. Check-in is at three p.m.
exchanges.hearZh: 抱歉，您的房间还没准备好。入住时间是下午三点。
exchanges.reply: Can I leave my luggage here?
exchanges.replyZh: 我能把行李寄存在这里吗？

exchanges.hear: Your room is on the eighth floor.
Breakfast is served from six thirty to ten on the second floor.
exchanges.hearZh: 早餐时间是六点半到十点，在二楼。
exchanges.reply: Great. And what's the Wi-Fi password?
exchanges.replyZh: 好的。无线网密码是什么？

exchanges.hear: There's a city tax of three euros per night.
exchanges.reply: Do I pay it now or when I check out?

exchanges.hear: Would you like to upgrade to a room with a view for twenty dollars more?
exchanges.hearZh: 加20美元可以升级到景观房，您需要吗？
exchanges.reply: No, thanks. The standard room is fine.
exchanges.replyZh: 不用了，谢谢。标准间就行。

lines.en: Good evening. Welcome to the Grand Hotel. Are you checking in?
lines.zh: 晚上好，欢迎来到格兰德酒店。您是办理入住吗？

lines.en: Yes. I have a reservation under the name Liu.
lines.zh: 是的。我用“刘”这个名字预订了。

lines.en: Let me see. Liu Yang, a double room for three nights?
lines.zh: 我看一下。刘洋，大床房，住三晚？

lines.en: May I have your passport and a credit card for the deposit?
lines.zh: 请给我您的护照，押金需要一张信用卡。

lines.en: Here you are. How much is the deposit?
Fifty dollars per night. It will be refunded when you check out.
Yes. Breakfast is from seven to ten on the first floor. Your room is twelve-oh-six, on the twelfth floor.
lines.zh: 含。早餐七点到十点，在一楼。您的房间是1206，在12楼。

lines.en: It's on this card. The elevators are on your right.
lines.zh: 写在这张卡上。电梯在您右手边。
